summary: fractal/source-map builds the fractal.source-map/v1 document of a rendered subject tree, with declaration → helper → value frames from a Bun read trace

schema.detail: No persistent schema changes; the document is the existing `fractal apply --source-map` input.

rules.detail: No runtime or policy rule changes.

compatibility.detail: A new entrypoint of the private TypeScript package; existing exports and rendered KDL are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No runtime deployment or migration changes.

manual.detail: No user action is required; loaders opt in by calling sourceMap and traceSourceReads.

recovery.detail: Loaders that stop calling the entrypoint publish without a source map, as before.
